summary: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of "Banderyol" cruise missiles and Shahed drones across Ukraine on 6 September 2026, killing two in Kyiv region and injuring seven in Khmelnytskyi, while Putin ordered a 72-hour halt on Kyiv strikes and met US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow. Ukrainian strikes killed a Russian occupation official in Crimea and halted production at a major metallurgical plant in Dnipropetrovsk region. Russian forces claim capture of Kurtovka near Druzhkovka in Donetsk region and report shooting down 258 Ukrainian UAVs overnight.
key_points: Putin ordered a three-day halt on strikes against Kyiv from midnight 6 September 2026 while meeting US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow. (Source: @UkraineNow/83908)
Ukrainian air strike killed Russian occupation official Oleksiy Chernyshov near Skvortsove, Crimea, per Ukrainian sources. (Source: @UkraineNow/83909)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in Donetsk People's Republic. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)

Overnight 6 September, Russian "Banderyol" cruise missiles and Shahed drones attacked multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Khmelnytskyi, Odesa, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73778, @eRadarrua/111030, @UkraineNow/83911)

Russian strike on Khmelnytskyi 5 September hit residential building, injuring seven; explosions also reported in Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi 6 September targeting Nova Poshta facilities. (Source: @eRadarrua/111031, @UkraineNow/83906)
Russian air defense claims 258 Ukrainian UAVs shot down overnight over Russian regions and Black/Azov seas. (Source: @tass_agency/394004)
Ukrainian missile strike on night of 5 September halted production at Metinvest's Kametstal plant in Kamenske, Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)
Russian strikes on Odesa region border infrastructure 6 September damaged Orlivka ferry complex and checkpoint in Izmail district, suspending crossing operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/111088)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial assault on 6 September 2026 employing "Banderyol" cruise missiles and Shahed drones across at least eight Ukrainian regions, resulting in two deaths in Kyiv region's Lisne village and seven injuries in Khmelnytskyi from a prior strike. Simultaneously, Putin announced a 72-hour pause on Kyiv strikes while hosting US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow, who are expected in Kyiv the same day. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian occupation official in Crimea and a major metallurgical plant in Dnipropetrovsk region, while Russian forces claim territorial gains near Druzhkovka.

points: Ukrainian air defense engaged a massive Russian aerial attack overnight 6 September involving numerous "Banderyol" cruise missiles and Shahed drones across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Khmelnytskyi, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, and Mykolaiv regions; at least two killed and one injured in Lisne, Bucha district, Kyiv region; seven injured in Khmelnytskyi residential building strike on 5 September. (Source: @UkraineNow/83911, @eRadarrua/111031, @mon1tor_ua/73778)

Ukrainian strike eliminated Russian occupation official Oleksiy Chernyshov, director of Putin's movement in Crimea, near Skvortsove village, Simferopol district, via air attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/83909)
Ukrainian missile strike on night of 5 September halted production at Metinvest's Kametstal plant in Kamenske, Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)
Ukrainian Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko reportedly missing since Friday amid anti-corruption investigation into call center protection schemes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33039)

Ukrainian air defense activity recorded across multiple regions: air raid alert in Kyiv 02:22-02:44 on 6 September; Shahed drones tracked over Kharkiv, Cherkasy, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Sumy regions overnight. (Source: @eRadarrua/111085, @eRadarrua/111086, @mon1tor_ua/73778)

Russian President Putin ordered three-day cessation of strikes on Kyiv from midnight 6 September 2026, announced by Kremlin spokesman Peskov, coinciding with meeting of US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow. (Source: @UkraineNow/83908, @UkraineNow/83903)

Russian forces launched large-scale overnight aerial attack 6 September employing "Banderyol" cruise missiles and Shahed drones against multiple Ukrainian regions, utilizing low-altitude flight profiles to evade detection, per Ukrainian monitoring channels. (Source: @eRadarrua/111091, @mon1tor_ua/73778)
Russian Ministry of Defense claims liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in Donetsk People's Republic. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)
Russian air defense systems reportedly destroyed 258 Ukrainian UAVs overnight over Russian regions and Black/Azov seas, per MoD statement. (Source: @tass_agency/394004)
Russian strikes on Odesa region border infrastructure 6 September damaged Orlivka ferry complex and checkpoint in Izmail district, suspending crossing operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/111088)
Three civilians injured in Rostov-on-Don from Ukrainian attack, per regional governor. (Source: @tass_agency/394006)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern fronts, posing threat of air strikes on frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/76751)
Russian MoD claims capture of Kurtovka near Druzhkovka in Donetsk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern directions, threatening frontline areas with air strikes. (Source: @kpszsu/76751)
UAV activity reported in Kramatorsk area. (Source: @kpszsu/76764)
Russian forces struck Ukrainian positions in southern grouping zone, destroying shelter with personnel, pickup truck, and radar per Russian MoD video. (Source: @tass_agency/394016)

Multiple "Banderyol" cruise missiles transited Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region (Boryspil, Brovary districts) and Sumy region (Okhtyrka district) overnight 6 September. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73778, @kpszsu/76729, @kpszsu/76731)
Jet UAVs detected in Kharkiv region: near Zmiiv heading to Merefa, in Berestynsky district heading northeast, and on Sakhnovshchyna. (Source: @eRadarrua/111064, @kpszsu/76775, @eRadarrua/111030)
